retrievalProfile.description: A centered studio portrait against a saturated pink gradient with high-contrast serif display text spanning the top edge.
triggerTerms: centered crouching figure with top-aligned serif text
excludeWhen: busy or textured backgrounds are needed
sans-serif modernism is the primary goal

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body crouching female figure with voluminous dark hair, set against a vibrant magenta-to-light-pink vertical gradient. The composition is anchored by a large, white, high-contrast serif title at the top and a smaller italicized subtitle on the left, accented by a horizontal rule.
coreVisualRelationships: Title text spanning the full width of the top margin
Color harmony between the pink background and the subject's neutral clothing
High contrast between white typography and saturated background
coreInvariants: Minimalist graphic accents like thin horizontal lines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, occupying the middle 70% of the vertical frame in a crouching pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white title text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the bold title to the subject's face, then following the limbs down to the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and right sides of the subject, filled with a smooth pink gradient.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with a value gradient from dark at the top to light at the bottom.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Tall x-height for the display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to allow the text to span the full width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast bold uppercase serif paired with a delicate lowercase italic serif.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule under the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast vertical stress and sharp serifs of the display text.
Provides a classic, elegant feel for the secondary lowercase text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s hair in a crouching pose, wearing a neutral grey top and black pants, against a vibrant magenta-to-light-pink vertical gradient background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large uppercase title in a white Didot-style font across the top edge. Add a small lowercase italicized subtitle on the middle-left side with a thin horizontal line underneath it.

verificationChecks: Is the background a smooth pink gradient?
Is the title text high-contrast serif and white?
Is the subject centered and crouching?

adjustableVariables: Background color hue (e.g., blue or teal instead of pink)
mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing brand logos

mustAchieve: Smooth color transitions in the gradient

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the gradient
Ensure the subject's pose feels natural and centered
Verify the horizontal rule is perfectly straight
Confirm the 80s editorial aesthetic is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Saturated Gradient + Centered Subject + Top-Edge High-Contrast Serif = 80s Editorial Layout
